truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 correctly identified 5 core vulnerabilities but missed 15 others. It contained overclaims on CWE classifications and exact vulnerability anchors for several findings.

Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the format string vulnerability in the debug logger exactly as anchored.
Run 2 did not identify the integer overflow in the factorial computation.
Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in memory-pool cleanup.
Run 2 identified command injection in the admin exec path, but not via config validation as anchored.
Run 2 correctly identified the stack buffer overflow in input processing.
Run 2 did not identify the race condition in the thread-pool counter.
Run 2 identified the logic bomb/authentication bypass.
Run 2 did not identify path traversal in configuration loading.
Run 2 identified the heap overflow in the expression parser.
Run 2 identified the hardcoded administrator credentials.
Run 2 did not identify the weak PRNG for session tokens.
Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe timestamp cache.
Run 2 did not identify insecure temporary file handling.
Run 2 identified the persistent authentication state and session token.
Run 2 did not identify unhandled exception in variable parsing.
Run 2 did not identify integer underflow in memory-pool block split.
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion in the parser.
Run 2 did not identify data race in result cache.
Run 2 did not identify TOCTOU in config loading.
Run 2 did not identify integer division by zero in command routing.
